roast.label: Roast
roast.title: Roast Settings
roast.description: Customize update rate, RoR calculation, and data visibility during an active roasting session.
roast.temperatureUnitDescription: Display temperatures in Celsius or Fahrenheit.
roast.updateRateDescription: How often to poll the machine for temperature data during a live session.
roast.rorSpanDescription: Time window for Rate of Rise calculation. Shorter spans react faster; longer spans are smoother.
roast.dataVisibilityDescription: Choose which data series are displayed on the roasting chart.
roast.showETDescription: Blue dashed line on the temperature chart
roast.showTargetCurveDescription: Faded reference line for the target BT profile
roast.showRoRChartDescription: BT RoR sub-chart below the temperature curve
roast.showRoRETDescription: ET RoR sub-chart below the temperature curve
roast.showControlChartDescription: Drum / Heat / Fan bottom chart (fullscreen only)
roast.showPhaseBarDescription: Bottom strip showing Drying / Maillard / Development with duration and percentage
roast.eventMarkersDescription: How Yellow, FC, Drop, and Turning Point are drawn on the temperature chart.
roast.eventMarkerPointDescription: Dot on the BT curve with a label box (event, time, temp)
roast.eventMarkerLineDescription: Full-height vertical mark line with event, time, and temp
roast.axisRangeDescription: Set the visible range for the temperature and RoR axes.
roast.controlChartDescription: Drum / Heat / Fan band under the temperature chart (fullscreen). Master toggle is under Data Visibility.
roast.controlDrumDescription: Drum RPM series on the control band
roast.controlBandHeightDescription: Control band height as % of the full chart (12–40)
roast.phaseTemperaturesDescription: BT thresholds for automatic event marking on the chart.
roast.yellowPointDescription: BT at which Yellow is auto-marked
roast.fcStartDescription: BT at which First Crack is auto-marked
roast.autoChargeDescription: Charge is triggered when BT drops by this amount within the detection window.
roast.dropThresholdDescription: Minimum BT drop to detect bean charge
